title: Questions 147-149 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE: Switch to the RouteWise Platform

Due to the shortcomings of our existing route-planning system, we are moving to a new platform called RouteWise. This is an attempt to answer the many complaints we have received about wrong routes being assigned to two drivers and long waits at the loading area. RouteWise will greatly reduce these problems, guaranteeing that routes are allocated correctly and increasing the general productivity of our drivers.

As we introduce the new platform, we must strive to deliver the high standard of service that our customers expect. This is why it is essential for all drivers to quickly adapt to it and learn how to make full use of its many tools. To achieve this goal, we will run a series of practice sessions next week in the main conference room to familiarize everyone with the RouteWise system.
